answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The ember edge is logged both ways, so a closed ring of 72 clones produces a signature the knoll analysis flags immediately. An adversary must hence build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the garden settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 38 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
